# xeRAbora for Android (archived)

> **This repository is archived.** The Android app is now part of xeRAbora itself: get
> `xerabora-android.apk` from the [xeRAbora releases](https://github.com/hacan359/xerabora/releases),
> and report issues at [hacan359/xerabora](https://github.com/hacan359/xerabora).

This fork is where the Android port started. It went into xeRAbora in
[30a785c](https://github.com/hacan359/xerabora/commit/30a785cac4e87cb70e699e3e84faa2514bdb8084),
first released in alpha.14, and the official app updates itself from the official releases.

**Using an APK from this repository?** The official app is a separate app, with its own package name and
signing key, so it installs next to this one. Install it, sign in again, then uninstall this one.
